experiment: S4 partial observability / state-estimator test (obs masking)

protocol.masking_choice: obs are zero-padded from D_real to 128 at train time, so zero is the learned 'no observation' sentinel in model input space; masked real dims are zeroed, never imputed. Mask draws cover real dims only (padded dims are always zero = permanently unobserved). k = max(1, round(frac*D_real)) per (env, frac); dim sets are fixed per (env, frac, seed) and shared across models (paired comparison). cartpole D_real=2 makes 25% and 50% coincide (1/2 dims); cheetah D_real=9 gives 2/9 vs 4/9.
protocol.window: win* = same k dims zeroed at EVERY frame of the 27-frame window (history-redundancy control); last* = last frame only
protocol.latents: model(o,a)['emb'][:, -1] at position t from 27-frame window forwards (all models prefix-causal; clean and masked share the same forward path)

metrics.rel_l2: mean ||z_mask - z_clean|| / (||z_clean|| + 1e-8) over all windows, averaged over mask seeds (primary)
metrics.cos_dist_aux: mean cosine distance (auxiliary; saturates for small-norm latents)
metrics.r2_drop: probe_r2_clean - r2_masked; ridge probes (standardized, alpha=1.0) fit ONCE on clean latents z -> s_{t+Delta}, episode-level 75/25 split; masked latents scored with the same fixed probe on the same held-out windows
